61: /**

67: 	@Override
68: 	public void handle(final AnnotationValues<ExtensionMethod> annotation, final JCAnnotation source, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
69: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.EXTENSION_METHOD_FLAG_USAGE, "@ExtensionMethod");
70: 		
71: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, ExtensionMethod.class);
72: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
73: 		boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface = isClassOrEnumOrInterface(typeNode);
74: 		
75: 		if (!isClassOrEnumOrInterface) {
76: 			annotationNode.addError("@ExtensionMethod can only be used on a class or an enum or an interface");
77: 			return;
78: 		}
79: 		
80: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
81: 		
82: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
83: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
84: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
85: 			return;
86: 		}
87: 		final List<Extension> extensions = getExtensions(annotationNode, extensionProviders);
88: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
89: 		
90: 		new ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(annotationNode, extensions, suppressBaseMethods).replace();
91: 		
92: 		annotationNode.rebuild();
93: 	}

98: 		for (Object extensionProvider : extensionProviders) {

101: 			if (!("class".equals(provider.name.toString()))) continue;

103: 			if (providerType == null) continue;
104: 			if ((providerType.tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) continue;
105:

107: 			extensions.add(new Extension(typeNode.getExtension(tsym), tsym));

129: 			this.extensions = extensions;
130: 			this.suppressBaseMethods = suppressBaseMethods;

147: 			if (methodCallNode == null) {
148: 				// This should mean the node does not exist in the source at all. This is the case for generated nodes, such as implicit super() calls.
149: 				return;
150: 			}

154: 			TypeSymbol surroundingTypeSymbol = ((JCClassDecl)surroundingType.get()).sym;

156: 			String methodName = methodNameOf(methodCall);

158: 			if ("this".equals(receiver.toString()) || "this".equals(methodName) || "super".equals(methodName)) return;
